title: Add color and size SKU variants to Product master data
description: Close the audited Product master-data gap by adding optional color and size SKU variants beneath the existing product record. Existing products without variants must continue to behave as single non-variant products. This task may add repository schema code and validate against non-production test databases, but it must not backfill historical documents, split existing inventory, execute production SQL, deploy, or reinterpret historical product references.
acceptance_criteria: Users can maintain zero or more active SKU variants for an existing product, with a server-validated variant code and optional color and size values; at least one of color or size is required for a variant.
Variant codes are unique within a product after normalization, and duplicate active color/size combinations within the same product are rejected instead of silently merged.
Product list or detail workflows expose variant count and a bounded variant-maintenance view without replacing the existing product identity.
Existing products with no variants remain readable and editable with unchanged behavior and require no production backfill.
Creating, editing, disabling or deleting a variant does not rewrite historical inquiry, quotation, order, stock or movement lines and does not split or recalculate existing inventory.
Disabled or historically referenced variants remain readable where an existing persisted reference is available but cannot be newly selected as active master data.
Repository schema changes are idempotent and are validated only through permitted local or test-database paths; production database execution remains behind the mandatory human gate.
Unit/integration tests cover create, update, duplicate protection, disable, legacy products without variants and non-mutation of historical product/inventory records; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open an existing Product, add distinct color and size variants, and verify the variants and count persist in the Product detail workflow.
Attempt to add a duplicate variant, then disable an existing variant and verify legacy Product data remains readable without changing stock or historical documents.

human_gate.reason: Repository master-data code and non-production test schema only. Production schema execution, historical inventory migration, deployment and release remain prohibited without human approval.
